I'm a medicine intern and I'm here to share my daily experiences here as a part of my internship completion.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nToday's case :\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nA 45 year old male came to opd with chief complaints of decreased appetite since 1 month and loose stools since 20 days\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHOPI\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 month back then developed decreased appetite , Increased chest discomfort immediately on taking food , gradually progressed\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nLoose stools since 20 days watery consistency, normal colour\u0026nbsp; 4 episodes per day not blood stained patient. but, now complains of blood stained stools 1 episode per day normal consistency since 2 days after using medication\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPatient complains of generalized weakness and not able to do daily activities\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBelching present\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNo h\/o fever, vomitings, pain abdomen,chestpain,cough ,sob.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPast history:\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nK\/c\/o HIV since 9 years\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nOn regular medication TLE regimen\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCD4+ count= 500cells\/cu.mm on 4-07-2019\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPt is on INH from 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNo h\/o Hypertension , diabetes, asthma , epilepsy\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNot a k\/c\/o TB.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr
